prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
The evidence is still thin.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Postpone account sign in after pet selection: Move the sign-in step after users pick their pet and create the adoption certificate, reducing initial drop-off. (why: 72.9% sign_in conversion with a 567s mean time indicates users are stalled by upfront authentication before committing to a pet.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop pet placement diagnostic screen: Insert a short desktop visibility verification screen right after the waiting stage to ensure the pet rendered on screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or app not opening, contributing to high wait/finish times.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Split account sign in screen with account persistence guarantee: Redesign sign_in screen to split layout featuring a dedicated reminder about log-in account matching. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different or fresh account.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Custom pet generation retry flow: Add an instant preset fallback option inside the pet selection flow if photo processing stalls or custom rendering fails. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high at 60.9%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account recovery notice on sign in screen: Add a prominent hint below the sign-in options reminding users to sign in with their existing account to restore pets. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets due to signing into duplicate accounts.)
5: [home, wait_info] Estimated wait time counter and status updates: Show dynamic time estimates and live status steps while waiting for pet generation to complete. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off during background generation.)
6: [finish, notification] Interactive control overview on home intro: Display an active desktop notification on home_intro explaining basic pet interactions. (why: 3 support emails mentioned confusion on how to control, hide, or speak to the pet after onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story scroll overview redesign: Redesign the story intro screen into a story scroll layout highlighting core app capabilities before pathway selection. (why: 76.2% conversion on choose_path with a 514s mean time suggests users spend significant time deciding without clear context.)
8: [adoption, layout] Card layout for adoption certificate stage: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a card layout with step counters to emphasize creation progress. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and a high mean time of 1017s.)

scores.note: Postponing sign-in builds pet investment before auth, targeting 27.1% sign-in drop-off.
Adding new screens shows negative lift in prior tests (-0.8%) despite support email evidence.
Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and funnel drop-off, but requires screen redesign.
Targets lowest converting step (60.9%) backed by 3 support emails reporting creation failures.
Very low cost text hint addressing top support issue (8 emails) on account confusion.
Directly tackles massive wait times (mean 2336s) during generation step.
Resolves user confusion reported in 3 support emails at finish step (64.8% conversion).
High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation, but full redesign is expensive.
High potential impact by focusing on adoption (lowest funnel step at 60.9%), but funnel-only evidence.
